tagline: Art prints from a small studio

posts.title: New: The Riso Moon Run
content: Fifty copies, two colors, one slightly temperamental risograph. The Riso Moon print is finally in the shop.
Each one comes out a little different — that is the riso promise and the riso threat. Numbers 1 through 50, signed.
comments: Number 7 arrived today. The misregistration is perfect.

drafts.title: How We Mix Riso Inks
content: Soy based, a little translucent, and never quite the same blue twice. This is the part of the job that still feels like magic.
Reorder the fluorescent pink drum before the holiday run.

drafts.title: Custom Wedding Prints: What to Send Us
content: Names, date, two colors you both agree on, and a deadline that gives the ink a week to dry. That is all we need to start.
